Padua International Excellence Scholarship 2027/28

Offered by the University of Padua for international students enrolling in a master's degree.

Deadlines

Applications open on 2 February 2027 and close on 15 March 2027 at 13:00 (CET). Results by 30 April 2027.

Eligibility

Applicants must be under 30 years of age at the deadline and hold a bachelor's degree. English at B2 level: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 90.

Documents

  • Copy of passport (PDF, max 10 MB)
  • Transcript of records with grading scale
  • Motivation letter, 1 page (optional)

Data cannot be changed after submission. Application fee: EUR 30.
